description: Run a multi-step churn investigation against your Stripe cancellations. Pre-buckets cancellations into segments (by plan tier, voluntary/involuntary, recency) and lets Claude drill into 1-3 segments before synthesizing a markdown report. More expensive than analyze_stripe_churn (multiple Claude calls) but produces deeper analysis. Requires STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

focus.description: Optional focus to bias the investigation (e.g., 'pricing', 'involuntary churn').

lookback_days.description: How many days back to investigate. Defaults to 90. Min 7. Max 365.

name: investigate_churn
title: Investigate Churn (multi-step)
